rationale: A wins because its best work is built around hard editor questions, not cute frames: "Do not pitch this without the filings check — the whole angle collapses if the number is disclosed somewhere" is exactly the adult supervision this update needs. B has useful bones, but it sells lines like "Restaurants are borrowing from their point-of-sale system instead of their bank" before proving restaurants are actually choosing Toast instead of banks. A is not flawless — "Toast reached profitability by selling loans, not hardware" overstates the supplied facts — but it catches more real stories and polices its own evidence better.
gaps_in_A: "Toast reached profitability by selling loans, not hardware" overclaims causation; the update only says Toast reached profitability and that lending/fintech are higher-margin than hardware.
"won't say how many fail to repay" is hotter than the fact block. "Default rates on advances not disclosed" is an absence, not proof Toast refused to answer.
"an industry with well-known failure rates" imports outside context not supplied in the update; it may be true, but the angle set was supposed to stay inside the evidence.

"no current signal" undercuts the supplied why-now. The company update itself says bundling and 120,000 locations are current; the next step should also include filings/customer proof, not only `newsjack-detector`.
gaps_in_B: "Restaurants are borrowing from their point-of-sale system instead of their bank" invents bank displacement. The update says Toast offers advances; it does not say operators are replacing community banks or traditional lenders.
"Tipped wages, split shifts, and the payroll problem restaurant software keeps dodging" decorates one thin fact with unsupplied compliance pain and an invented industry failure.
"Toast got profitable by selling money, not hardware" makes the same causation leap without enough guardrails. Higher margin is not the same as proving the profit driver.

It treats the sharpest material as cleanup, not story: "Why are default rates on Toast Capital advances undisclosed?" belongs closer to the center, and the fee complaints could support a lock-in angle B never really builds.
